messages:
june: rolling the hotfix to prod now, slice-3 first. ETA ~3m. can people run quick smoke checks when it lands? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: deploy completed: hotfix/patch-421 -> production (slice-3) by @june
marco: on it — i'll run the health probes and latency pings against slice-3. posting results in a sec.
priya: i'm monitoring error-rate and inference latency dashboards (prod / model-serving). will call out any spikes.
liam: quick sanity commands in case useful:
```
# health
curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.internal/health | jq '.'
# sample generate
curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"hello"}'
```
marco: health ok on all 3 instances in slice-3, 200/200. p50 gen latency steady ~45ms. no errors in logs for last 2m. :white_check_mark:
priya: traffic shift looked clean. small CPU bump on one node (60% -> 72%) but nothing sustained. keeping an eye.
liam: QA smoke run: sample prompts all returned expected tokens, embedding endpoints also OK. no regressions in our quick diff suit.
qa-bot: smoke-suite: 12/12 passed, regression-score delta: +0.0
marco: rolling to slice-4 next (canary +1). if slice-4 looks good i'll open the rollout to remaining slices.
june: thanks — please call out if you see error-rate >0.5% or p95 gen >250ms. rollback plan is tagged in the release notes if needed.
priya: noted. small note — cache hit rate dropped by ~3% after the patch, likely warmup. expect it to recover over 10-15m.
liam: quick rollback readiness check: rollback playbook ready, infra runbooks pinned in the release thread, db migration no-op (no migration).
june: great. if all good by +15m we'll consider this closed. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
marco: slice-4 looks healthy as well. merging rollout to remainder now.
priya: monitoring window started. will post final signoff or escalate.
qa-bot: final signoff will post after 15m stable window.
june: final: 20m stable, no errors, metrics within thresholds. closing handoff — thanks everyone. :tada:
